description.value:
After Kang Tao gifted a A-22B Chao prototype to a chinese military officer, they and their COs were amazed with its accuracy and power, but raised issues with its comfort and lack of concealability. So, when Kang Tao released the finalized model — which sacrificed firepower for better comfort and concealability — the chinese army rejected it, and instead ordered more of the original prototype. Thus, despite being a capable smartlinked variable-burst heavy sidearm, the A-12A Kaishi is never featured in Kang Tao's marketing to avoid irony.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: Excellent Quality Very Heavy Pistol • Skill: Handgun • Range: Pistol

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 18 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4)

Concealable: No

Slots: 0 • Attachments: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild • Mods: None

Special Features: Incompatible with Capacity modifying Attachments. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. Using Autofire with this weapon expends 6 rounds instead of 10 [Efficient Autosear]. This weapon can be reloaded without an Action by its user sacrificing their Move Action as long as they have at least one other empty hand.

Range: Pistol
Pre-installed: Efficient Autosear, Smart Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4)

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
